reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering grass, paths, algae, crops, Green Rain weeds, slime ranching, tea, a quest heirloom, fish, hardwood, food, and hay were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover placement, possible drops, crop texture, established fish and resource names, item gender, and approved glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

GrassStarter_Description.source: Place this on your farm to start a new patch of grass.
GrassStarter_Description.translation: Așază-l la ferma ta pentru a crea un nou petic de iarbă.

GravelPath_Description.source: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
GravelPath_Description.translation: Așaz-o pe sol pentru a crea poteci sau pentru a-ți înfrumuseța podelele.

GreenBean_Description.source: A juicy little bean with a cool, crisp snap.
GreenBean_Description.translation: O păstaie mică și zemoasă, proaspătă și crocantă.

GreenRainWeeds_Description.source: Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
GreenRainWeeds_Description.translation: Pot conține Fibre sau Semințe amestecate.

GreenSlimeEgg_Description.source: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.
GreenSlimeEgg_Description.translation: Poate ecloza într-un Incubator de Slime.

GreenTea_Description.source: A pleasant, energizing beverage made from lightly processed tea leaves.
GreenTea_Description.translation: O băutură plăcută și energizantă, făcută din frunze de ceai prelucrate doar puțin.

Halibut_Name.preservationReason: Halibut is the standard Romanian fish name already used throughout the locale and therefore remains identical to the English source.

Halibut_Description.source: A flat fish that lives on the ocean floor.
Halibut_Description.translation: Un pește plat care trăiește pe fundul oceanului.

Hardwood_Description.source: A special kind of wood with superior strength and beauty.
Hardwood_Description.translation: Un tip de lemn deosebit, cu rezistență și frumusețe superioare.

HardwoodFence_Name.translation: Gard din lemn de esență tare

HardwoodFence_Description.source: The most durable type of fence.
HardwoodFence_Description.translation: Cel mai durabil tip de gard.

Hay_Description.source: Dried grass used as animal food.
Hay_Description.translation: Iarbă uscată folosită ca hrană pentru animale.
